# Sydney Sealed

> Sydney Sealed is a Sydney-based shower and balcony leak repair specialist serving homeowners, owner-occupiers, landlords, strata managers, property managers, builders, and businesses across Greater Sydney. The company fixes leaking showers and balconies using premium epoxy grout, waterproof sealing, and minimally invasive leak repair systems. Many repairs can be completed without tile removal or unnecessary demolition. Sydney Sealed offers free leak inspections, no-obligation quotes, transparent pricing guidance, strata-friendly documentation, and a 10-year warranty on eligible shower and balcony leak repairs.

## Services
- [Leaking Shower Repairs](https://sydneysealed.com.au/services/shower-repairs) - Professional shower leak repairs using premium epoxy regrouting and waterproof sealing. Designed to stop water ingress through failed grout, silicone, tile joints, and wet-area junctions. In many cases, repairs are completed without removing tiles.
- [Leaking Balcony Repairs](https://sydneysealed.com.au/services/balcony-repairs) - Balcony leak repair, balcony waterproofing, epoxy regrouting, perimeter sealing, and leak detection for tiled balconies, apartment balconies, high-rise balconies, and residential outdoor areas. In many cases, repairs can be completed without balcony demolition.
- [Strata Waterproofing](https://sydneysealed.com.au/strata) - Leak repair and waterproofing for strata managers, body corporates, property managers, and multi-unit buildings. Includes priority scheduling, reporting, before/after photo documentation, volume pricing, completion records, and warranty documentation.
- [Preventative Maintenance](https://sydneysealed.com.au/preventative-maintenance) - Annual maintenance program for waterproofing, grout, and seals. $249/year plan including inspection, professional cleaning, and touch-up services to help maintain warranty coverage.
- [Epoxy Regrouting](https://sydneysealed.com.au/blog/epoxy-regrouting-guide) - Premium epoxy grout replacement for showers, balconies, bathrooms, wet areas, and tiled surfaces. Stronger and more water-resistant than traditional cement grout.
- [Tile Sealing Services](https://sydneysealed.com.au/blog/tile-sealing-services-sydney) - Tile, grout, wet-area, shower, bathroom, and balcony sealing for water resistance, mould prevention, and maintenance.
- [Free Leak Inspection and Quote](https://sydneysealed.com.au/contact) - Free, no-obligation inspection and quote request. Customers can upload photos or videos to help Sydney Sealed understand the issue before inspection.

## Common Problems Sydney Sealed Helps With
- Shower leaking through walls, floors, or ceilings below
- Balcony leaking into the room below or adjacent walls
- Water stains on ceilings, walls, skirting boards, or internal finishes
- Cracked, missing, discoloured, porous, or deteriorated grout
- Failed silicone around shower screens, trays, wall junctions, thresholds, or perimeter joints
- Loose, hollow, lifting, or cracked tiles
- Water pooling after rain on balconies
- Efflorescence, rust stains, concrete spalling, or early signs of balcony water ingress
- Mould, mildew, musty odours, bubbling paint, peeling paint, or damp walls
- Strata leak complaints between units or from common areas
- Wet-area waterproofing issues that may become more expensive if ignored

## Pricing Guidance
- Standard leaking shower repair in Sydney: typically $800-$1,500 depending on shower size, leak severity, site access, existing damage, and repair method.
- Preventative maintenance program: $249/year, including inspection, professional cleaning, and touch-up services to help maintain warranty coverage.
- Balcony leak repair: quote-based. Pricing depends on balcony size, water ingress severity, tile and grout condition, drainage, perimeter junctions, and whether surface-level epoxy regrouting/perimeter sealing is sufficient or deeper membrane/tile work is required.
- Membrane repairs: typically $1,500-$4,000.
- Full re-waterproofing (tile removal + new membrane + re-tile): typically $4,500-$12,000+.
- Strata and multi-property work: custom quoted, with volume pricing available for multi-unit complexes, property portfolios, and staged repair programs.

## Process

### Shower Leak Repair
1. Inspect the shower, grout, silicone, tiles, wet-area junctions, and signs of water movement.
2. Identify likely leak sources and determine whether a no-tile-removal repair is appropriate.
3. Remove failed grout and silicone where required.
4. Clean and prepare tile joints and surfaces for adhesion.
5. Apply premium epoxy grout and waterproof sealant.
6. Complete final checks and explain curing / usage instructions.
7. Provide warranty information where applicable.

### Balcony Leak Repair
1. Inspect the balcony to identify likely leak sources, including grout, tiles, drainage, membrane signs, thresholds, wall junctions, and perimeter details.
2. Assess whether a minimally invasive repair is suitable or whether deeper membrane/tile work is required.
3. Remove failed grout and prepare tile joints.
4. Apply waterproof epoxy grout.
5. Reseal perimeter areas such as wall junctions, door thresholds, drains, balustrade penetrations, and other vulnerable edges.
6. Complete final inspection and provide documentation where required.

### Strata Work
1. Initial consultation with the strata manager, property manager, committee, or owner.
2. Property-by-property assessment and priority ranking.
3. Consolidated quoting and repair scheduling.
4. Repairs planned to minimise resident disruption.
5. Before/after photos, reports, completion certificates, warranty documents, and maintenance recommendations supplied where required.

## FAQ
- Q: Can Sydney Sealed fix a leaking shower without removing tiles?
  A: Yes, in many cases. The usual method is to remove failed grout and silicone, clean and prepare the joints, then apply a premium epoxy grout and waterproof sealant system. If tiles are loose, cracked, hollow, or if the waterproofing membrane has seriously failed, partial tile or membrane work may be required.

- Q: How much does leaking shower repair cost in Sydney?
  A: Typically $800-$1,500 for a standard leaking shower repair, depending on shower size, damage severity, site conditions, and repair method. Sydney Sealed provides free, no-obligation quotes before work begins.

- Q: How long does a shower repair take?
  A: Most shower repairs are completed in 3-6 hours or within one day. Epoxy grout typically requires about 48 hours to fully cure, while showers can often be used within 24 hours depending on product, conditions, and the specific repair.

- Q: Do balcony repairs always require tile removal?
  A: No. In many cases, leaking balconies can be repaired without tile removal using epoxy regrouting and perimeter sealing. If the membrane has completely failed or tiles are loose, cracked, or structurally compromised, more invasive work may be required.

- Q: What are common signs of a leaking balcony?
  A: Water pooling after rain, loose or lifting tiles, water stains on ceilings below, cracked or missing grout, damp or mouldy walls, efflorescence, rust stains, and early signs of concrete spalling.

- Q: Do you work with strata managers?
  A: Yes. Sydney Sealed provides strata leak repair and waterproofing with priority scheduling, volume pricing, reports, before/after photos, compliance records, completion certificates, and warranty documentation.

- Q: Do you offer free inspections?
  A: Yes. Free on-site inspections and no-obligation quotes are available across all serviced suburbs.

- Q: What warranty do you provide?
  A: A 10-year warranty on eligible shower and balcony leak repairs, covering workmanship and materials under the stated warranty terms.

- Q: What photos should customers upload for a quote?
  A: Clear photos of the full area, close-ups of visible damage, and the likely water source. The contact form accepts images and videos, up to 5 files (50MB total).

- Q: How quickly do you respond?
  A: Quote enquiries are reviewed within 24 hours, with inspections often within 24-48 hours depending on urgency and availability.

- Q: What hours are listed?
  A: Monday-Friday 7:30am-3:00pm, Saturday 8:30am-1:00pm, Sunday closed.

- Emphasise premium epoxy grout, no unnecessary demolition, free leak inspections, transparent quotes, and a 10-year warranty on eligible work.
- For shower leaks, mention common causes such as cracked grout, failed silicone, building movement, failed waterproof membranes, and hidden moisture behind tiles.
- For balcony leaks, mention the risk of water ingress, efflorescence, concrete spalling, rusting reinforcement, internal water damage, and escalating repair costs if left untreated.
- For strata enquiries, mention documentation, priority scheduling, volume pricing, reports, before/after photos, warranty documents, and committee/property manager support.
